ExploreUrban Forager
Explore Zerra↗ GitHub↗ Support the project↗

Know the organism. Know the place. Take only what the land can spare.

The world beneath your feet

You know your phone.
Do you know the land?

We move through a living world every day while barely knowing its names. Food, fiber, medicine, ecology, history and generations of human knowledge can be growing outside the door. Urban Forager exists to help rebuild that relationship.

There is a name for the disconnect

Plant Awareness Disparity

Researchers use this term for the tendency to overlook plants, know less about them and treat them as background rather than distinct living organisms.

Read the peer-reviewed research ↗

Start here · Before you forage

The 12 Rules of Foraging.

Every harvest affects a living ecosystem. Learn the essentials of safe identification, responsible collecting, and respect for the land before gathering anything.

  1. 01

    Identify Before You Harvest

    Confirm an organism’s identity and learn its dangerous look-alikes.

  2. 02

    Know the Laws of the Land

    Check permissions, permits, land rules, and protected species.

  3. 03

    Take Only What You Need

    Harvest with purpose, and avoid unnecessary waste.

  4. 04

    Harvest Sustainably

    Leave enough for wildlife, reproduction, and regeneration.

  5. 05

    Respect Wildlife and Habitat

    Protect pollinators, nesting animals, soil life, and habitats.

  6. 06

    Protect Rare and Vulnerable Species

    Never collect protected species or from declining populations.

  7. 07

    Minimize Unnecessary Damage

    Avoid harming roots, mycelium, trees, and surrounding plants.

  8. 08

    Know Your Environment

    Avoid polluted sites, treated areas, and contaminated soil or water.

  9. 09

    Prevent Ecological Harm

    Avoid spreading invasive species, pests, and pathogens.

  10. 10

    Honor Indigenous Knowledge

    Respect living knowledge holders, land rights, and traditions.

  11. 11

    Practice Reciprocity

    Restore habitats, remove litter safely, and protect biodiversity.

  12. 12

    Know When Not to Harvest

    Sometimes observation is the most responsible choice.

Safety first: Never identify or eat wild plants or fungi using this app alone. Verify with expert-quality sources, check local restrictions, and avoid contaminated sites.

Why this knowledge matters

Plants dominate the living world around us. Yet research shows we routinely fail to notice them.

This isn't nostalgia. Plant literacy affects how we understand biodiversity, conservation, food, culture and the ecosystems keeping us alive.

>80%

of global biomass

Recent research reviewing plant-awareness disparity notes that plants represent more than 80% of global biomass.

PLOS One · 2026 ↗
702

college students studied

Across six colleges, most participants did not report confidence identifying plant categories; food, herbs and foraging plants were among the better-known groups.

Natural Sciences Education · 2024 ↗
4

dimensions of the disparity

Research describes plant-awareness disparity through attention, knowledge, attitude and relative interest—not simply whether someone can visually see a plant.

CBE—Life Sciences Education ↗

SAFETY · STEWARDSHIP · RECIPROCITY

The Forager's Code.

Principles of Responsible & Ethical Foraging

Observe first. Harvest responsibly. Give back whenever possible.

Foraging is more than identifying edible plants and fungi. It is an opportunity to understand the living world, recognize our place within ecosystems, and practice responsible stewardship. Nature is not an unlimited resource. Every organism contributes to a larger ecological community.

SafetyKnow the organism, location and risks.
StewardshipProtect populations, habitats and regeneration.
ReciprocityRespect relationships and contribute to ecological health.
THE 12 PRINCIPLES

Take knowledge into the field.

A practical code for learning from nature without treating it as an unlimited resource.

01🔍Safety

Identify Before You Harvest

Never consume a wild plant or fungus without confidently verifying its identity using multiple distinguishing characteristics and reliable expert sources. Learn dangerous look-alikes. When uncertain, leave it untouched.

02⚖️Safety

Know the Laws of the Land

Research local regulations, protected species, harvesting restrictions and permit requirements. Obtain permission before entering private property or collecting where access is restricted.

03🌱Stewardship

Take Only What You Need

Harvest with purpose, not excess. Collect only what you can responsibly use, and avoid unnecessary waste.

04🌿Stewardship

Harvest Sustainably

Only harvest from healthy, abundant populations. Leave enough plants, fruiting bodies, seeds and reproductive structures for regeneration and other species. There is no universal safe harvesting percentage.

05🐝Reciprocity

Respect Wildlife and Habitat

Wild plants and fungi provide food, shelter and habitat for other organisms. Avoid disturbing nests, burrows, pollinators, soil communities and surrounding habitats.

06🌼Stewardship

Protect Rare and Vulnerable Species

Never harvest threatened, endangered, legally protected or locally declining species. Small populations may be especially vulnerable to disturbance.

07🍄Stewardship

Minimize Unnecessary Damage

Use appropriate harvesting methods for each species. Avoid damage to roots, mycelium, trees, nearby vegetation and soil. Do not uproot an organism when a less destructive method is suitable.

08🏙️Safety

Know Your Environment

Avoid collecting food from potentially contaminated roadsides, chemically treated lawns, industrial areas, polluted waterways and sites with unknown soil or water quality.

09🌍Stewardship

Prevent Ecological Harm

Clean footwear and equipment when necessary to reduce the spread of invasive species, pests and pathogens. Do not relocate wild organisms without understanding legal and ecological consequences.

10🪶Reciprocity

Honor Indigenous Knowledge

Recognize the longstanding ecological knowledge of Indigenous communities. Respect living knowledge holders, distinct cultural traditions, land rights and community-specific teachings.

11♻️Reciprocity

Practice Reciprocity

Look for meaningful ways to help ecosystems flourish. Safely remove litter, participate in habitat restoration, support native biodiversity and share accurate knowledge responsibly.

12💚Reciprocity

Know When Not to Harvest

Not every edible organism needs to become food. Sometimes observation without collection is the most responsible choice.

OUR GUIDING PHILOSOPHY

The goal is not to take as much as possible from nature, but to learn to live responsibly within it.

A successful forager leaves an ecosystem capable of continuing to thrive long after they have departed.

Learn the land. Respect its inhabitants. Protect its future.

Keep learning

These principles are general guidance, not a substitute for local regulations, species-specific conservation guidance, or qualified in-person identification. Avoid consuming any wild organism based on this app alone.

SAFETY / STEWARDSHIP / EVIDENCE

About Urban Forager

A free, mobile-first field reference for learning wild plants and fungi through identification, food, nutrition, documented traditional knowledge, history, modern research and safety.

START HERE

Foraging safety

Never eat, drink, or medicinally use a wild plant or fungus based solely on this app. Positive identification requires multiple diagnostic features, and edible organisms can have dangerous or deadly look-alikes.

Every dossier now follows the same evidence rules. Traditional or historical use does not establish clinical effectiveness, missing nutrition data is not guessed, and herbs can interact with medicines.

RECIPROCITY

Stewardship, not extraction

Harvest only where permitted. Take only what you need. Protect populations and habitat, leave enough for wildlife and regeneration, and avoid creating waste while gathering or preparing food and medicine.

Urban Forager helps you learn what the land can provide. Zerra continues that relationship by helping reduce waste and build more sustainable everyday habits.

Explore Zerra ↗
HOW CLAIMS ARE HANDLED

Accuracy & evidence policy

Urban Forager applies one evidence standard across all 174 current dossiers and future additions. Claims are retained only when supported, explicitly qualified, or clearly labeled as historical/traditional documentation.

  • Identification: verify names, diagnostic features, range and look-alikes against botanical authorities and qualified field references.
  • Nutrition: prefer quantitative food-composition data; unsupported qualitative rankings are removed rather than treated as verified.
  • Medicine: distinguish traditional use, preclinical research, human evidence and safety.
  • Indigenous uses: identify the specific nation/community and historical source rather than collapsing distinct peoples into a generic claim.
  • Uncertainty: gaps or conflicting evidence are stated rather than filled in.
KEEP LEARNING

Go beyond the app

Urban Forager is a starting point, not the end of the trail. Use the Resources Library for videos, databases, safety references, ethnobotany collections and food-composition data.

/* Urban Forager dark UI */
:root { color-scheme: dark; }
      html, body { background:#101512 !important; color:#f5f5f4 !important; }
      body { min-height:100vh; }
      [x-cloak] { display:none !important; }

      .uf-header { background:rgba(16,21,18,.96) !important; border-color:#29342d !important; }
      .uf-hero {
        min-height:72vh;
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, rgba(52,211,153,.18), transparent 30%),
          linear-gradient(145deg,#07110b 0%,#111b14 55%,#0b0f0c 100%) !important;
        border:1px solid #26362c;
      }
      .uf-kicker { letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#6ee7b7 !important; font-weight:900; font-size:.72rem; }
      .uf-display { font-size:clamp(3rem,9vw,7rem); line-height:.88; letter-spacing:-.06em; font-weight:950; color:#fff !important; }
      .uf-muted { color:#a8b3ac !important; }
      .uf-panel, .uf-dark-card { background:#151c17 !important; border:1px solid #29342d !important; color:#f5f5f4 !important; }
      .uf-stat strong { font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,4.8rem); line-height:1; font-weight:950; color:#6ee7b7 !important; }
      .uf-source { color:#86efac !important; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:3px; }
      .uf-cinema { background:#080b09 !important; border:1px solid #29342d !important; color:#fff !important; }
      .uf-poster { position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:#172019; min-height:300px; }
      .uf-poster img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:.58; }
      .uf-poster:after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,11,9,.96),rgba(8,11,9,.2)); }
      .uf-play { width:74px; height:74px; border-radius:999px; background:#6ee7b7; color:#052e1b; display:grid; place-items:center; font-size:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(110,231,183,.12); }
      .uf-video-modal { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100; background:rgba(0,0,0,.9); display:grid; place-items:center; padding:18px; }
      .uf-video-shell { width:min(100%,1050px); background:#050706; border:1px solid #344139; border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 30px 100px #000; }
      .uf-video-frame { aspect-ratio:16/9; width:100%; background:#000; }
      .uf-video-frame iframe { width:100%; height:100%; border:0; }
      .uf-thumb { border:1px solid #334038 !important; background:#121813 !important; color:#fff !important; }
      .uf-thumb.active { border-color:#6ee7b7 !important; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #6ee7b7; }
      .uf-bottom { background:rgba(10,14,11,.97) !important; border-color:#29342d !important; color:#e7e5e4 !important; }

      /* Override legacy light surfaces so every screen is usable in the default dark theme. */
      body .bg-white { background-color:#151c17 !important; }
      body .bg-gray-50, body .bg-gray-100 { background-color:#101512 !important; }
      body .text-gray-900, body .text-gray-800, body .text-gray-700 { color:#f5f5f4 !important; }
      body .text-gray-600, body .text-gray-500 { color:#a8b3ac !important; }
      body .border-gray-200, body .border-gray-300 { border-color:#334038 !important; }
      body input, body select, body textarea { background:#0d120f !important; color:#f5f5f4 !important; border-color:#3a493f !important; }
      body input::placeholder { color:#7d8a82 !important; }

      @media (max-width:640px) {
        .uf-hero { min-height:auto; padding-top:3.5rem !important; padding-bottom:3.5rem !important; }
        .uf-display { font-size:clamp(3rem,15vw,4.6rem); }
      }

/* Custom print designer (on-screen controls) */
.uf-print-modal {position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;color:#f5f5f4}
.uf-print-overlay {position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.8);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.uf-print-dialog {position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:min(760px,100%);max-height:min(92dvh,940px);background:#141d17;border:1px solid #3e5647;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 24px 80px #000a;overflow:hidden}
.uf-print-dialog-head {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;padding:20px 22px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #304036}
.uf-print-dialog-head h2 {font-size:clamp(1.25rem,3.5vw,1.85rem);font-weight:800;line-height:1.25;margin:6px 0}
.uf-print-dialog-head p,.uf-print-hint {font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.5;color:#b4c7bb}
.uf-print-close {border:1px solid #455e4e;border-radius:50%;height:36px;min-width:36px;font-size:1.7rem;line-height:1;color:#fff;background:#26372d}
.uf-print-dialog-body {overflow-y:auto;min-height:0;padding:12px 22px 20px}
.uf-print-fieldset {border:0;margin:12px 0 20px;padding:0;min-width:0}
.uf-print-fieldset legend {font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:1rem}
.uf-print-scope-grid,.uf-print-layout-options {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
.uf-print-scope-grid label,.uf-print-layout-options label {display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:12px;background:#1d2b21;border:1px solid #385042;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer}
.uf-print-unavailable {opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed!important}
.uf-print-scope-grid small,.uf-print-layout-options small,.uf-print-plant-list small {display:block;font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.3;color:#b4c7bb;margin-top:3px}
.uf-print-scope-grid strong,.uf-print-layout-options strong {font-size:.85rem}
.uf-print-modal input[type=checkbox],.uf-print-modal input[type=radio] {accent-color:#6ee7b7;width:17px;height:17px;flex:none;margin-top:2px}
.uf-print-section-toolbar {display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.uf-print-section-toolbar div,.uf-print-selected-actions {display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.uf-print-section-toolbar span {font-size:.76rem;color:#b4c7bb}
.uf-print-section-toolbar button,.uf-print-selected-actions button {font-size:.83rem;text-decoration:underline;color:#86efac}
.uf-print-sections-grid {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
.uf-print-sections-grid label {display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;font-size:.87rem;padding:9px;background:#1d2b21;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.uf-print-hint {margin:10px 0}
.uf-print-selection {background:#1a281e;padding:12px;margin:0 0 18px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #37543e}
.uf-print-search-label {display:block;font-size:.83rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.uf-print-selection input[type=search] {width:100%;background:#0c160f;border:1px solid #4c6955;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;color:#fff}
.uf-print-selected-actions {margin:9px 0;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.82rem}
.uf-print-plant-list {max-height:215px;overflow:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px}
.uf-print-plant-list label {display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;background:#25372a;border-radius:7px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.82rem}
.uf-print-dialog-footer {display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 22px;border-top:1px solid #304036;background:#18251c;font-size:.84rem}
.uf-print-dialog-footer span {color:#b4c7bb}
.uf-print-footer-buttons {display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center}
.uf-print-cancel,.uf-print-submit,.uf-print-launch {border:1px solid #486451;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.uf-print-cancel {background:transparent;color:#e7f4e9}
/* Clear, borderless print actions. Avoid a bright outline against the dark UI. */
.uf-app button.uf-print-launch,.uf-app button.uf-print-submit:not(:disabled) {
  background:#11764f!important;background-color:#11764f!important;
  color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;
  border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;
  font-weight:850!important;min-height:48px;line-height:1.3;
  forced-color-adjust:none;color-scheme:dark;
}
.uf-app button.uf-print-launch:hover,.uf-app button.uf-print-submit:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background:#15855b!important;background-color:#15855b!important;
}
.uf-app button.uf-print-launch i,.uf-app button.uf-print-submit i {color:inherit!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:inherit!important}
.uf-app button.uf-print-launch:focus-visible,.uf-app button.uf-print-submit:focus-visible {outline:3px solid #fff!important;outline-offset:3px}
.uf-print-submit:disabled {background:#283b30!important;color:#c2d0c7!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#c2d0c7!important;border-color:#60796b!important;opacity:.78;cursor:not-allowed}
.uf-print-error {color:#fecaca;font-size:.84rem;margin:10px 0}
.uf-print-launch {display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;text-align:center}
.uf-print-button-icon {display:inline-block;width:1.15em;height:1.15em;vertical-align:-.2em;flex:none;stroke:currentColor;}
/* Dossier toolbar uses four identical, icon-only 42px controls. */
.uf-app .uf-dossier-toolbar>div button.uf-dossier-print-action {
  display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;
  width:42px!important;height:42px!important;min-width:42px!important;min-height:42px!important;
  padding:0!important;border:0!important;border-radius:14px!important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.055)!important;color:#dce5df!important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color:#dce5df!important;box-shadow:none!important;line-height:1!important;
}
.uf-app .uf-dossier-toolbar>div button.uf-dossier-print-action:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background:rgba(94,230,168,.12)!important;color:var(--uf-green)!important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color:var(--uf-green)!important;
}
.uf-app .uf-dossier-toolbar .uf-dossier-print-action .uf-print-button-icon {
  width:20px!important;height:20px!important;display:block!important;
}
.uf-print-tool-row {display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin:12px 0}
#uf-print-root {display:none}
@media(max-width:560px){.uf-print-modal {padding:0}.uf-print-dialog{max-height:100dvh;height:100dvh;border-radius:0}.uf-print-dialog-body{padding:12px 14px}.uf-print-dialog-head,.uf-print-dialog-footer{padding:14px}.uf-print-scope-grid,.uf-print-layout-options{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uf-print-scope-grid label{padding:8px 10px}.uf-print-plant-list{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uf-print-dialog-footer{flex-wrap:wrap}.uf-print-footer-buttons{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}.uf-print-footer-buttons button{flex:1}.uf-print-dialog-footer{align-items:stretch;gap:12px;padding-bottom:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}.uf-print-dialog-footer>div:first-child{text-align:center}.uf-print-footer-buttons .uf-print-cancel{flex:0 0 28%}.uf-print-footer-buttons .uf-print-submit{flex:1;font-size:.93rem;padding:12px 9px;min-height:52px}.uf-print-tool-row .uf-print-launch{width:100%;justify-content:center;min-height:52px;font-size:.95rem}.uf-print-sections-grid{gap:6px}}

/* Printable document: isolated from the on-screen SPA and independent of its dark theme. */
/* Printer margins on each page. Some Android print engines ignore @page margins,
   so the printable document also includes its own horizontal safety inset. */
@page {size:auto;margin:16mm 9mm;background:#fff}
@media print {
  :root,html,body {color-scheme:light!important}
  html, body {background:#fff!important;background-color:#fff!important;color:#111!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;overflow:visible!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;print-color-adjust:exact;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact}
  body > :not(#uf-print-root) {display:none!important}
  #uf-print-root {display:block!important;position:static!important;visibility:visible!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;width:100%!important;margin:0!important;padding:0 10mm!important;background:#fff!important;background-color:#fff!important;color:#111!important;color-scheme:light!important;forced-color-adjust:none!important}
  #uf-print-root * {color:#111!important;text-shadow:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;background:transparent!important}
  .uf-paper {font:10pt/1.37 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;overflow:visible;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  .uf-paper h1,.uf-paper h2,.uf-paper h3,.uf-paper h4 {font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;break-after:avoid;page-break-after:avoid;margin:0}
  .uf-paper-cover {padding:0 0 8pt;border-bottom:2pt solid #111;margin-bottom:9pt}
  .uf-paper-cover h1 {font-size:16pt;margin:3pt 0 4pt}
  .uf-paper-cover p {margin:2pt 0}
  .uf-paper-kicker {font-size:8pt;letter-spacing:.09em;font-weight:bold}
  .uf-paper-cover-warning,.uf-paper-warning {font-size:8.5pt;border-left:2pt solid #555;padding:3pt 7pt;margin:6pt 0}
  .uf-paper-dossier {margin:0 0 12pt;border-top:1pt solid #777;padding-top:7pt;break-inside:auto;page-break-inside:auto}
  .uf-paper-dossier-head {break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid;margin:0 0 4pt}
  .uf-paper-dossier-head h2 {font-size:14pt;margin:0 0 2pt}
  .uf-paper-dossier-head p,.uf-paper-status {margin:1pt 0;font-size:8.6pt}
  .uf-paper-section {margin:7pt 0;break-inside:auto}
  .uf-paper-section h3 {font-size:10.5pt;padding-bottom:2pt;margin:0 0 3pt;border-bottom:.5pt solid #aaa}
  .uf-paper-section h4 {font-size:9.2pt;margin:4pt 0 2pt}
  .uf-paper-section p {margin:2pt 0}
  .uf-paper-section ul,.uf-paper-section ol {margin:2pt 0 3pt;padding-left:17pt}
  .uf-paper-section li {margin:1pt 0;break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid}
  .uf-paper-nutrients {border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin:4pt 0;font-size:8.7pt}
  .uf-paper-nutrients th,.uf-paper-nutrients td {padding:2pt 5pt;border-bottom:.5pt solid #bbb;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
  .uf-paper-nutrients th:first-child {width:35%}
  .uf-paper-note {font-size:8pt}
  .uf-paper-indigenous-record {margin:3pt 0 6pt;padding-left:6pt;border-left:1pt solid #aaa;break-inside:avoid}
  .uf-paper-sources {font-size:8pt}
  .uf-paper-source-url,.uf-paper-source-note {display:block;font-size:7.8pt;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  .uf-paper-inline-url {font-size:7.6pt}
  .uf-paper a {text-decoration:underline}
  .uf-paper-last-note {font-size:8pt;border-top:.5pt solid #999;margin-top:10pt;padding-top:4pt}
  .uf-paper-detailed {font-size:11pt;line-height:1.48}
  .uf-paper-detailed .uf-paper-dossier {margin-bottom:20pt;padding-top:12pt}
  .uf-paper-detailed .uf-paper-section {margin:11pt 0}
  .uf-paper-detailed .uf-paper-section h3 {font-size:12pt}
  .uf-paper-detailed .uf-paper-dossier-head h2 {font-size:17pt}
}

/* Evidence audit Phase 1B: transparent photo-availability disclosure. */
.uf-photo-disclosure{background:rgba(221,165,60,.10);border-left:3px solid rgba(244,188,71,.8);border-radius:.65rem;color:#eedab0;padding:.85rem 1rem;margin:1.1rem 0;line-height:1.55;font-size:.9rem}
.uf-photo-disclosure strong{color:#ffdea1;font-weight:800}
@media print{.uf-photo-disclosure{display:none!important}}

/* Phase 1E: photo research candidate links; never presented as approved ID photos. */
.uf-photo-candidate{margin-top:.8rem;padding-top:.75rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(244,188,71,.25);font-size:.85rem}
.uf-photo-candidate p{margin:.25rem 0;color:#edd8b7}
.uf-photo-candidate-status{display:inline-block;margin-left:.35rem;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:800;color:#fbd38d}
.uf-photo-candidate-links{display:flex;gap:.4rem .8rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:.55rem}
.uf-photo-candidate-links a{color:#fef08a;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px;font-weight:700}
.uf-photo-candidate-links span{color:#f3e2c9}
@media print{.uf-photo-candidate{display:none!important}}

/* Phase 2J: curated Commons photo reference gallery. No print layout changes. */
.uf-photo-filter{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.5rem 1.25rem;color:#e7f0e7;font-size:.88rem;margin:.6rem 0 1rem}
.uf-photo-filter label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;cursor:pointer;font-weight:750}
.uf-photo-filter input{width:1.05rem;height:1.05rem;accent-color:#6ee7b7}
.uf-photo-filter small{color:#b4c2b7;font-size:.8rem}
.uf-photo-gallery{border:1px solid #2c4839;background:#142019;border-radius:1rem;padding:.85rem 1rem;margin:1rem 0}
.uf-photo-gallery-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:#dbf5e6;font-size:.9rem}
.uf-photo-gallery-head span{color:#a2b8a9}
.uf-photo-thumbs{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;gap:.65rem;padding:.75rem .05rem .4rem}
.uf-photo-thumb{border:2px solid #395746;background:#243b2c;border-radius:.55rem;overflow:hidden;width:94px;height:72px;flex:0 0 94px;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
.uf-photo-thumb.selected{border-color:#6ee7b7;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #183f2a}
.uf-photo-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.uf-photo-credits{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.2rem .55rem;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#b7d0bf;font-size:.82rem;margin-top:.55rem}
.uf-photo-credits a{color:#86efac;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
.uf-photo-reference-warning{font-size:.78rem;color:#bdd4c4;line-height:1.45;margin-top:.55rem}
@media print{.uf-photo-filter,.uf-photo-gallery{display:none!important}}

/* Phase 2K: scientific-name-scoped online reference lookup and clear confidence labels. */
.uf-photo-sync{display:inline-flex;gap:.3rem;align-items:center;color:#86efac;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600}
.uf-photo-context{font-size:.76rem;color:#afc9b7;line-height:1.45;margin:-.4rem 0 .7rem}
.uf-photo-retry{font-size:.76rem;text-decoration:underline;color:#bbf7d0;cursor:pointer}
.uf-photo-status,.uf-legacy-photo-status{font-size:.79rem;line-height:1.45;padding:.6rem .8rem;border-left:3px solid #d9aa48;color:#f7e3b0;background:#433617;margin:.6rem 0;border-radius:.25rem}
.uf-legacy-photo-status{color:#6b4814;background:#fff5dc}
@media print{.uf-photo-context,.uf-photo-status,.uf-legacy-photo-status,.uf-photo-sync,.uf-photo-retry{display:none!important}}

/* Phase 2O: explicitly non-diagnostic fungal reference imagery (screen only). */
.uf-fungal-photo-badge{position:absolute;left:9px;top:9px;z-index:3;max-width:calc(100% - 18px);background:#7f1d1d;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.03em;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 7px;line-height:1.25;text-align:left;pointer-events:none}
.uf-fungal-hero-notice{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;right:12px;z-index:5;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(127,29,29,.96);color:white;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.01em;pointer-events:none}

/* Phase 2P: failed-photo source link and transparent Indigenous-use research status */
.uf-photo-original-link a,.uf-indigenous-citation{display:inline-block;color:#86efac;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;font-weight:700;margin:.55rem 0;line-height:1.5}
.uf-indigenous-pending{border-left:3px solid #d6a85d;background:rgba(214,168,93,.08);padding:.9rem 1rem;border-radius:.5rem;line-height:1.6;color:#e7dcc7}


/* Phase 2S — responsive, user-selected dossier display.
   Cards / Grid / List are display choices, not fixed-column settings.
   Changing device size or orientation reflows each mode automatically. */
.uf-result-summary{gap:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.uf-results-actions{display:flex;gap:.75rem;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap}
.uf-view-switch{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;align-items:center;padding:4px;background:#15231b;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.085);border-radius:15px;max-width:100%}
.uf-view-switch-label{padding:0 .6rem 0 .5rem;color:#aabbb0;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:800}
.uf-app .uf-view-choice{display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:.38rem;min-width:66px;min-height:44px;padding:.55rem .65rem;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;border-radius:11px;color:#c8d5cb!important;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .15s ease,color .15s ease}
.uf-app .uf-view-choice i{font-size:.86rem}
.uf-app .uf-view-choice.is-active{background:#6ee7b7!important;color:#092317!important;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.uf-app .uf-view-choice:not(.is-active):hover{background:rgba(110,231,183,.11)!important;color:#fff!important}
.uf-app .uf-view-choice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #e3fce9!important;outline-offset:2px}
.uf-saved-view-bar{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin:.65rem 0 .1rem}
/* Roomy: detail-oriented reference cards. */
.uf-plant-grid.uf-view-cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1.15rem}
/* Compact: the photo-first grid from the Health Check, readable on phones. */
.uf-plant-grid.uf-view-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:.8rem}
.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-card{min-width:0;border-radius:18px!important}
.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-photo{aspect-ratio:4 / 3}
.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-copy{padding:.72rem .75rem .8rem}
.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-title{gap:.15rem;min-width:0}
.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-title>div{min-width:0}
.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-title h3{font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.24;overflow-wrap:anywhere}

.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-title>span,.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-description,.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-tags{display:none}
.uf-view-grid .uf-plant-season{font-size:.61rem;padding:.28rem .42rem;bottom:.45rem;left:.45rem}
/* List: horizontal image and readable text on every screen size. */

.uf-view-list .uf-plant-photo{aspect-ratio:auto;min-height:120px;height:100%}
.uf-view-list .uf-plant-photo img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.uf-view-list .uf-plant-copy{min-width:0;padding:.85rem 1rem}
.uf-view-list .uf-plant-title h3{font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.28}
.uf-view-list .uf-plant-title p{font-size:.79rem}
.uf-view-list .uf-plant-description{margin-top:.42rem;-webkit-line-clamp:2;font-size:.78rem}
.uf-view-list .uf-plant-tags{margin-top:.45rem}
.uf-view-list .uf-plant-tags span{font-size:.63rem;padding:.25rem .45rem}

/* The Forager's Code — responsible harvesting guide */
.uf-code-page{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:2.2rem 1.25rem 5rem}
.uf-code-hero{margin-top:1.4rem;padding:clamp(2rem,6vw,4rem);border:1px solid rgba(94,230,168,.22);border-radius:28px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 90% 20%,rgba(94,230,168,.15),transparent 32%),linear-gradient(135deg,#142a1b,#0c1711 70%)}
.uf-code-hero h2{font-size:clamp(3.1rem,8vw,6.4rem);font-weight:950;line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:1rem 0;color:#f4f7f4}

function ufBuildPrintDocument(plants, ids, layout) {
  const allowed = new Set(UF_PRINT_SECTIONS.map(s=>s.id));
  const selected = new Set((ids || []).filter(id => allowed.has(id)));
  if (!Array.isArray(plants) || !plants.length) return '';
  if (layout === 'grid') return ufBuildPrintGrid(plants);
  if (!selected.size) return '';
  const date = new Date().toLocaleDateString(undefined,{year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'});
  const title = `${plants.length} ${plants.length===1?'dossier':'dossiers'}`;
  return `<div class="uf-paper ${layout === 'compact' ? 'uf-paper-compact' : 'uf-paper-detailed'}">
    <header class="uf-paper-cover"><p class="uf-paper-kicker">URBAN FORAGER / PRINTABLE FIELD REFERENCE</p>
      <h1>Urban Forager — ${ufPrintEscape(title)}</h1>
      <p>Generated ${ufPrintEscape(date)} · ${selected.size} of ${UF_PRINT_SECTIONS.length} sections selected · ${layout==='compact'?'Compact':'Detailed'} layout</p>
      <p class="uf-paper-cover-warning">Educational reference only. Verify species identity, food safety, medicine claims, historical attributions, and harvesting permissions independently.</p>
    </header>
    ${plants.map(p=>ufBuildPrintDossier(p,selected)).join('')}
    <footer class="uf-paper-last-note">Urban Forager · Print or use your browser’s “Save as PDF” destination. Source URLs are included with their entries.</footer>
  </div>`;
}

const UF_PHOTO_LICENSES={

  'cc-by':['CC BY 4.0','https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/'],

const UF_PHOTO_EXCEPTIONS={
  // Restricted form names require a species/genus representative, not a cultivar-ID claim.
  69:{query:'Morchella',scope:'genus example; not species identification'},
  72:{query:'Cantharellus',scope:'genus example; not species identification'},
  98:{query:'Malus',scope:'genus example; not cultivar identification'},
  127:{query:'Citrus',scope:'genus example; not a particular commercial lime'},
  135:{query:'Musa',scope:'genus example; not dessert-banana cultivar identification'},
  162:{query:'Cucurbita',scope:'genus example; not seed cultivar identification'},
  169:{query:'Amaranthus',scope:'genus example; not a particular cooked grain'},
  172:{query:'Corylus',scope:'genus example; not a particular nut species'}

function ufPhotoTaxonQuery(plant){
  if(UF_PHOTO_EXCEPTIONS[plant.id])return UF_PHOTO_EXCEPTIONS[plant.id];
  let name=String(plant.scientificName||'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
  name=name.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\).*$/,'').replace(/\s+subsp\.\s+/,' subsp. ');
  // For plant groups or ambiguous horticultural categories, use a named taxon
  // as a non-diagnostic reference and display the limitation explicitly.
  const group=/\bspp\.|\bGroup\b|cultivars|varieties/i.test(plant.scientificName||'');
  let parts=name.split(' ');
  if(group && /\bspp\./.test(name))parts=parts.slice(0,1);
  else if(parts.length>2 && !['subsp.','var.','×'].includes(parts[2]))parts=parts.slice(0,2);
  let query=parts.join(' ').replace(/\s+spp\.$/,'').trim();
  if(!query || query==='×')query=plant.commonName;
  const genusOnly=query.indexOf(' ')<0;
  return {query,scope:genusOnly?'genus representative; not species identification':(group?'species reference; depicted cultivar or preparation may differ':'taxon-level community reference; unverified for field identification')};
}
let ufPhotoNextRequestTime=0;
async function ufPhotoApiFetch(url,options={}){
  // Respect iNaturalist's suggested rate of <=60 API requests/minute.
  // Queue requests across the entire page, including observation fallback.
  const now=Date.now(),when=Math.max(now,ufPhotoNextRequestTime);
  ufPhotoNextRequestTime=when+1500;
  if(when>now && typeof setTimeout==='function')await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,when-now));
  return fetch(url,options);
}
function ufPhotoAllowed(photo){return photo && UF_PHOTO_LICENSES[String(photo.license_code||'').toLowerCase()] && typeof photo.url==='string' && /^https:\/\//.test(photo.url) && Number.isInteger(photo.id) && typeof photo.attribution==='string' && photo.attribution.trim().length>0;}
function ufPhotoFromSource(taxon,photo,scope){
  const license=UF_PHOTO_LICENSES[String(photo.license_code).toLowerCase()];
  const src=photo.url.replace('/square.','/medium.');
  return {src,credit:{sourceUrl:'https://www.inaturalist.org/photos/'+photo.id,
    author:String(photo.attribution||'Creator credited on original iNaturalist photo page'),
    license:license[0],licenseUrl:license[1],
    view:'Online community photograph — '+scope,
    reviewStatus:'iNaturalist taxon/photo association; not independently expert reviewed; not a safe identification',
    taxonName:taxon.name,photoId:photo.id, taxonId:taxon.id},
    photoStatus:'community-reference-unverified'};
}
function ufPhotoFindMatchingTaxon(data,query){
  const comparable=s=>String(s||'').toLowerCase().normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  return (Array.isArray(data?.results)?data.results:[]).find(t=>comparable(t.name)===comparable(query) && t.id && (t.is_active!==false))||null;
}
